from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single document regarding its citation relationships within the collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the document itself")
    cites_collection_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this document cites in its bibliography")
    has_external_citations: bool = Field(description="True if this document cites works outside of the provided collection")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[DocumentCitationInfo]
